en.body:
What's in the newsletter?  
  
📝 Registration open: Join us for the second Swiss conference on decentralized energy, happening on 22 May 2025 in Bern. Participation is free but spots are limited. [Register here.](/news/the-second-biennial-conference-of-sweet-edge-be-take-place-on-22-may-2025-in-bern/)  
  
🔥 Press releases: How would Switzerland handle a drop in gas and electricity imports? EDGE researchers modeled scenarios with reduced gas and electricity imports. Their results have been picked up by Swiss media.  
  
☀️ Local action: Wittenbach on the cover page of the St. Galler Nachrichten. From PV on rooftops to parking lots and farmland, Wittenbach is making important steps in local energy innovation.  
  
🎥 Meet our partners: Check out a new video series from the Energy Drinks event, featuring EDGE partners' interviews from EPFL, UNIGE, HSLU, BFH, and our guests from other SWEET projects.

📩 You want to subscribe to the newsletter? Do it [here](/index.html#newsletter-email).

[\-> Read the full newsletter](https://sh1.sendinblue.com/ai2m9djc79pfe.html?t=1744094910742)
